name: Rosemary
description: An evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean with fragrant, needle-like leaves and delicate white, pink, blue, or purple flowers.
use: Potatoes, bread and roast vegetables. Commonly added whole to roasted poultry and infused olive oils.
tips: Requires gritty, sharply draining soil and abundant direct sunlight. Avoid overwatering, as roots are prone to rot in soggy soil.
